high_priority.criteria: Primary vertical OR strong signal from DOCX notes + WhatsApp active + decision-maker reached
high_priority.action: Immediate outreach; target for Week 1-2 calls

medium_priority.criteria: Secondary vertical OR unclear fit + WhatsApp available
medium_priority.action: Scheduled outreach batch 2 (days 5-10); prepare discovery script

low_priority.criteria: No vertical signal + WhatsApp uncertain or international number
low_priority.action: Wave 2 (after Week 1) OR defer to contextual re-engagement
low_priority.target_response_time: Try once; if no response, defer to month 2

contact_grooming_process.step2_segment: Assign vertical based on available DOCX context or phone pattern
contact_grooming_process.step3_prioritize: Score high/medium/low based on vertical fit + completeness
contact_grooming_process.step4_batch: Divide into daily batches (8-12 per day)
contact_grooming_process.step5_track: Log attempt, response, outcome, next action in CSV
contact_grooming_process.step6_qualify: Move qualified prospects to proposal/call scheduling
